note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the word is generic and fictional, the definition and the clause are placeholders, never real contract text; times are fictional labels. "Defined term" and "term with no linked definition" are supplied, neutral configurations of equal weight: they only say where the supplied scenario shows the definition slip (in the contract's dock, a thread linking the word to it, or in the definitions sheet's dock, no thread). The substitution changes only the inspected label and its dependent state (the slip's dock and the thread). No interpretation rule (no contra proferentem, no plain meaning, no canon of construction), no conclusion about what the word means and no jurisdiction is stated. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): the clauses list (one clause: term.clause), schedules, the definitions list (one definition slip: definition) and priorities.
